title: Moment 6: Have fun, Your house and your town
intro: A short made-up storyboard from endgame.life. Amara finds tonight's plan without scrolling. Nothing here is real and nothing is sent.

steps.say: Made-up example, nothing is sent. Amara's dashboard knows what is in the house: board games, a guitar, flour and eggs.
It lists what is near her tonight: an open mic at 8 and a free outdoor film at 9.
It suggests an idea: bake first, then walk to the open mic.
Horror is left out, as she asked.
